blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Albion. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Albion, Maple Ridge: 18 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 22%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 4 of 12 Maple Ridge communities for condos and townhomes.

On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Albion rose from 17 in June to 18 in September (+5.9%), and 15 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 6.3% of Maple Ridge’s 286 condos and townhomes listed.

blocks.text: Albion home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

29 townhomes sold in Albion with a median price of $745,000 (the middle half sold between $699,900 and $800,500), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 98.2% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $525 per square foot, a median year built of 2016 and a median strata fee of $318 a month.

Streets, schools and getting around Albion

items.t: The City publishes no boundary for the MLS sub-area as such: UNVERIFIED as an official boundary; the Albion Area Plan's Schedule 1 map is the closest official boundary document.

Working geography: the east Maple Ridge growth area along Lougheed Highway around 240 Street, with residential corridors 240 Street, 102 Avenue and 104 Avenue, the Albion Fairgrounds/Sports Complex lands by the Fraser River, and farmland in South Albion. Nearby areas: Cottonwood and East Central to the west, Thornhill to the northeast, Kanaka Creek / North Maple Ridge ground to the north, and the Fraser River along the south edge.

Where the townhouse stock concentrates: entirely on the 240 Street corridor at 101–104 Avenue, beside the Albion Commercial Corner at 104 Avenue and 240 Street — all four verified complexes in stand within a few blocks of that corner.

Maple Ridge community medians (NOT Albion's; sub-area medians are not published — UNVERIFIED at sub-area level): Detached $1,131,000; Condos & Townhomes $525,000, $432/sq ft, 94% sale-to-list, 49 days on market.

SD42 runs K–7 elementary and 8–12 secondary, with no middle tier. The live area page mis-states two of these addresses (c'usqunela as "10445 240B Street" and Kanaka Creek as "11180 234A Street") — the Ministry figures govern, flagged in. Catchments are address-based through the SD42 School Locator; no locator result for an Albion address was run, so the catchment for any specific complex is UNVERIFIED.

Recreation and services: the Albion Fairgrounds hosts events year-round (including Country Fest, the Caribbean Festival and the Home Show) and the Albion Sport Complex is home to Planet Ice and the Golden Ears Winter Club (curling); Kanaka Creek Regional Park (Metro Vancouver) runs along the west side. No library branch sits in Albion — Maple Ridge Public Library is at 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road in the Town Centre. Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, is the community hospital; the Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 121 – 11900 Haney Place, open 7 days a week, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.

Transit: Haney Place Exchange is in the Town Centre to the west; the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus runs from Coquitlam Central Station to Haney Place. Which Haney Place diagram routes run on Albion streets was not re-verified route by route: UNVERIFIED. West Coast Express: Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) and Maple Meadows Station (20010 Dunn Avenue) serve the west side of the city on weekdays between Waterfront and Mission City. TransLink's Langley–Haney Place BRT is in detailed planning (22 km, peak service every 10 minutes; designs, costs and timelines not yet determined).

Floodplain: the south edge sits along the Fraser River and Kanaka Creek — flood construction level 6.7 m geodetic (including freeboard), no habitable floor space below it on affected lots, a covenant on title identifies floodplain construction, and Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h) prohibits rental accommodation (suites) on floodplain properties. The verified complexes sit on the 240 Street corridor north of the river flats; per-parcel status is UNVERIFIED.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Albion

items.t: Form B diligence (all four counted complexes are strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and a summary of the strata's insurance, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. For The Warwick, first establish whether the unit is a developer sale or a resale, because the document route differs.
Lougheed Transit Corridor note: Verify any corridor claim for a specific property on the City's current document.

Suites and SSMUH: one secondary suite per lot inside the single detached building, maximum 40% of gross floor area, not within the floodplain area; eligible single-detached and duplex lots may have up to three, four or six units under the City's SSMUH bylaws.

blocks.text: Good to know about Albion

items.t: The headline attached numbers overstate the condo supply — there is none.
The live area page mis-states two school addresses.

The Albion Area Plan update (Oct 28, 2025) plans family growth, not seniors housing — commercial nodes, walking/cycling links and farmland buffers, with added townhouse density contemplated along 248 Street in the North East Albion review; no age-restricted or seniors component is described in the plan material checked, which is why no 55+ supply is coming from the pipeline.

The fairgrounds are the area's event anchor. The City confirms the Albion Fairgrounds hosts events year-round (including Country Fest, the Caribbean Festival and the Home Show) and the Albion Sport Complex is home to Planet Ice and the Golden Ears Winter Club — event-weekend traffic on 240 Street and Jim Robson Way is part of living beside the 240/104 cluster.

Its 2021 figures for the sub-area (population 13,205; $131,000 median household income; 84% owner-occupied) are attributed to a custom compilation that could not be re-read and are UNVERIFIED, as are its "recent MLS snapshot" medians (detached $1,310,000; townhome $799,900; condo $492,000), which are not SnapStats figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Albion?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 18 condos and townhomes listed in Albion. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Albion a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Albion had a sales ratio of 22%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Albion from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 15 condos and townhomes sold in Albion over those 4 months, out of 184 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Albion sell for?
faq.a: 29 townhomes sold in Albion between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $745,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Albion?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.2% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Are there any apartment condos in Albion?
How many townhouse complexes are there, and where?
faq.a: Four verified, all strata, all within a few blocks of 104 Avenue / 240 Street: Albion Station (10151 240 Street), Ridgemont (24108 104 Avenue), Spencer Brook Estates (23986 104 Avenue) and The Warwick (10392 240A Street).

faq.q: Is The Warwick finished or still a presale?
faq.a: Both signals exist: the project package estimated completion in August 2025, while current listings record a 2026 build year and market the "last move-in ready home in Phase I." Treat status as per-unit and UNCONFIRMED at building level — a developer sale carries GST and REDMA rights; a resale runs on the Form B.

faq.q: What pets can I have at Spencer Brook Estates?
faq.a: The building record states pets restricted — cats and dogs OK, maximum 1 (directory/strata-record data). Pet bylaws survive the 2022 rental changes, so confirm the current registered bylaw on the Form B before writing an offer around a pet.

faq.q: Can I rent out an Albion townhome long-term?
faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since Nov 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. Short-term rentals can still be restricted; check the registered bylaws on the Form B.
